steps.say: Where the class is: every chapter taught, and where the last lesson stopped.
The next lesson, built from the teacher's own notes.
One tile per lesson up to the exam. Striped tiles land after it.
Show progress: the pace needed, the class's pace and the average learner's.
The agents write the next plan live: Principal, Librarian, Teacher, Examiner.
The Examiner caught a line the notes don't back. The Teacher fixed it.
Each learner sees the course as a tree. Filled leaves are done.
Pick a branch, a leaf or the trunk, then begin.
Ten floors a chapter, from recall to analysis. Every question cites the notes.
Five questions a floor. Say how sure you are, then answer.
Anyone can leave a note on any page: mark an area, say what to change.
Each note is picked up in seconds, fixed, and marked Done.
Every fix is cited: before and after, the files changed and the diff.
Built by the team's own notes agent, live, while they used the app.
The Principal answers questions about the class from its records.

steps.text: Who is behind, and what should I do this week?
steps.say: Ask anything. It names the learners, tests and lessons it used.
